description: Suivi de mouvements de terrain par nivellement de point au GPS à Villerville depuis 2008 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Monitoring of the evolution of ground movements estimated by the measurements of leveling of 21 points by mobile GPS, in Villerville, since 2008. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Tracking ground movements by point leveling at GPS in Villerville since 2008" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include mouvement de terrain, Natural risk zones, glissement, Environmental monitoring facilities, Elevation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
